Method of Attack: Unauthenticated File Upload vulnerability allowing threat actors to upload malicious and spam content to government web portals
Phishing lures on .gov and .mil domains pushing visitors into malicious redirects
Temporary hosting of unauthorized uploaded files for distribution
Impacted Systems: U.S. government sites using .gov and .mil domains
Websites of U.S. Senator Jon Tester
Government clients using Laserfiche Forms software
Attack Vector: Exploitation of unauthenticated file upload field in public Laserfiche Forms
Use of open redirect functionality on government websites
Indicators of Compromise: Spam content such as Viagra ads hosted on .gov and .mil domains
Google indexed government sites showing spam content
Previously accessible spam links now throwing errors after cleanup
